rationale: Seven members voted on topic t-01; the state is rejected because un-rebutted refutes (f-003 layout-expert, f-004 author, f-005 contrarian, f-007 librarian) reached the charter's reject quorum of 4 against three supports (f-001 researcher, f-002 game-architect, f-006 editor-in-chief). No judge was convened: the engine's check returned action=recommend on a terminal reject-majority, and no ruling was sealed, so rulings_applied is empty by construction. The split is real rather than a consensus artifact: the three supports cleared the chapter's NUMBERS, which the librarian independently re-derived and confirmed, while the four refutes found defects the numeric audit does not look for (a divergent passive key, a dropped sub-zero case, label placement, minus-glyph inconsistency, and name collisions). Both contested claims were adjudicated against the files: the contrarian's Insight claim is CORRECT in substance (ch07 keys Insight to Reason at 187, while ch13:224, ch13:508, ch14:30 and ch21:154 all derive passive Insight from Knowledge) but its ch14:111 citation is arithmetically wrong, and re-deriving it exposed two genuine ch14 defects instead; the author's name-collision claim was CONFIRMED on all four sub-claims and found wider than filed, since the Knowledge and Subterfuge group headings also collide with ch08 discipline categories. Both adjudications are recorded with their counter-arithmetic in f-007's evidence so the orchestrator can implement without re-deriving them.
